items.title: noahelhadedy/double-shot — Keeps your Mac awake. With the lid closed too, and for as long as your AI agents are working. Menu bar app for
items.summary: Download · brew install --cask noahelhadedy/tap/double-shot · Made by Noah Elhadedy You start a long Claude Code or Codex run, close the lid, put the Mac in your bag, and the work stops. Without an external display, macOS sleeps the moment the lid closes. caffeinate and most keep-awake apps only stop idle sleep, and the ones that handle a closed lid don't know when your agents are done. Double Shot handles both: - Stays awake while your agents work. It notices when Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor Agent, Copilot CLI, OpenCode, Amp or Aider are actually working, not just open.
